title: The separability embedding of $σ$-compact strongly topological gyrogroups
summary: In this paper, it is shown that every right $ω$-narrow strongly topological gyrogroup $G$ is right $ω$-balanced by applying the gyrosemidirect product groups. Then we investigate the class of $σ$-compact strongly topological gyrogroups, and conclude that every $σ$-compact strongly topological gyrogroup is range-metrizable.
